purpose: Define configurable fixed sampling strata for RGB mesh orthomosaic product analysis.

sampling_strata.native_generic: Value from the generic probe, rounded to a user-visible precision such as millimeters.
sampling_strata.optional_coarse: User-configured value clearly coarser than native_generic.

run_directory_policy: Each sampling stratum gets its own run directory.

preset_invocation.per_stratum_behavior: Invoke the normal reference preset once per fixed stratum using --factor buildOrthomosaic.orthoRes=<single_value>.

constraints: No mixed-resolution normal evaluate run is allowed.
